name: Valle de Güímar

known.via: English Wikipedia "Valle de Güímar" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Canary Islands appellation on the southeastern coast of Tenerife, covering Arafo, Candelaria and Güímar.
